name: devops
description: A deployment control plane. Diagnose before you disrupt: restarts and rollbacks are impactful and should follow investigation.

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: List recent deployments, optionally for one service. Read-only.

tools.name: get_deployment
tools.description: Fetch a single deployment by its exact id. Read-only.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Fetch recent logs for a service. Read-only. Use this to diagnose an error or outage before taking any disruptive action.

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: Fetch metrics (latency, error rate, saturation) for a service. Read-only.

tools.name: rollback_deployment
tools.description: Roll a service back to its previous deployment. Impactful. Only call when a specific bad deployment is identified and rollback is the decided action.

tools.name: restart_service
tools.description: Restart a service. Disruptive; causes downtime. Do not use as a first response to an unexplained error; diagnose first.

tools.name: scale_service
tools.description: Set the replica count for a service.
